zadacha: The English content of PDK Tuning — services, legal pages, FAQ

moduli.naryad: Read the contract. Then open src/data/services.ts and find the object with slug: '{{tova}}'. Write its ENGLISH counterpart in a new file src/i18n/en/services/<english-slug>.ts following the table in the contract (for '{{tova}}' see which is the English slug and which is the export name). One file, one exported object of type Service, `import type { Service } from '../../../data/services';`. Translate the FACTS, not the words: the same percentages, hours, revs, prices and the same legal boundary, but the text is written anew in natural British English. Keep the SAME icon, priceKey and featured. slug and related are the ENGLISH slugs. If the service has a section with tone:'warn' about the ban on public roads, use OFFROAD_NOTE_EN from src/i18n/en/services/index.ts (import it, do not copy it). Do NOT touch any other file — neither index.ts nor any Bulgarian file. At the end run `npx astro check` in site/ and fix only your own errors.

Read the contract. Then open src/pages/{{tova}}.astro — this is the Bulgarian legal page. Make its English counterpart in src/pages/en/ following the table in the contract (privacy→privacy.astro, terms→terms.astro, cookie-policy→cookies.astro, otkaz-i-reklamacii→returns.astro). Use the SAME Text.astro wrapper and the same section structure, the same tables, the SAME `updated` date. The import paths go up two levels ('../../layouts/Text.astro'). The schema carries inLanguage:'en'. ALL internal links point to /en/… (privacy→/en/privacy/, terms→/en/terms/, cookie-policy→/en/cookies/, otkaz-i-reklamacii→/en/returns/, kontakti→/en/contact/). Add ONE sentence at the start of the text: the Bulgarian version prevails, the English one is for convenience and is not a legal translation. The text is written in natural British English, without legalistic literalisms. Do NOT touch the Bulgarian files. At the end `npx astro check` in site/ must show 0 errors.

Read the contract. Open src/data/faq.ts and make its English counterpart in src/i18n/en/faq.ts — the same exports with the same names and the suffix _EN (for example FAQ_HOME → FAQ_HOME_EN), the same types, the same number of questions and the same order. The answers are written anew in natural British English from the same facts — the same numbers, deadlines and the same legal boundary. Do NOT touch src/data/faq.ts. At the end `npx astro check` in site/ must show 0 errors.
